title: binder
summary: Current build-5875 binder wire is implemented: CMSG_BINDER_ACTIVATE 0x01B5, SMSG_PLAYERBINDERROR 0x01B6, SMSG_BINDPOINTUPDATE 0x0155, SMSG_PLAYERBOUND 0x0158, and SMSG_BINDER_CONFIRM 0x02EB. Exact body parsers cover confirm, player-bound and bind-point; PLAYERBOUND closes the pending prompt, always plays SoundEntries 1141, and posts the resolved area success line.

openItems.text: Deterministic parser/opcode checks pass. Needs authenticated packet evidence for SMSG_BINDER_CONFIRM, SMSG_PLAYERBOUND and SMSG_BINDPOINTUPDATE; SMSG_PLAYERBINDERROR remains named but intentionally unpresented because current Benilla does not consume it.
